product_title: Traditional Krishna Pearl Toran with Lotus & Elephant Motifs
product_description: Welcome tradition and elegance into your home with this handcrafted toran, featuring a beautiful Lord Krishna centerpiece, pink lotus motifs, decorative elephants, intricate golden detailing, and graceful pearl hangings. Perfect for Diwali, Janmashtami, pooja rooms, weddings, and festive entrance décor.
product_care_suggestion: Dust gently with a soft, dry cloth.
Keep away from water, moisture, and direct sunlight.
Handle pearls and decorative motifs carefully.
Store in a cool, dry place after use.
